title: attention_notice: request
description: From v0.3: the only way a decision attempt of the farm manager seat reaches people. The core checks every field by code and builds the notice manager_attention; code chooses the recipients (MGR-52). There is no free text, command or link.

object.description: An object id from the tenant catalog.

proposal.description: What the manager proposes: an operation code, or the id of a card or proposal that code issued.

op.description: Operation code: an operation of spec/model/control-ops.yaml that a core may serve to the seat (MGR-9, MGR-15), or a service verb as service_<verb> (MGR-52). notify is not one: from v0.3 this notice is the only way the seat reaches people. The list is closed so that no free model text reaches people; a core offers only the operations it serves, a subset of this list.
